Component.description: Category of metadata (e.g. Tools, Publications, etc.); provide the same one for all items/rows.
Component.title: Component

GrantNumber.description: The identifier associated with the award funding this study.
GrantNumber.title: grantNumber

StudyAttribution.description: The funder-, contributor-, patient-, etc., derived content that includes terms, conditions, or statements associated with accessing and reusing the resource(s). Maps to DUOplus7.
StudyAttribution.title: studyAttribution

StudyCollaborationRequired.description: Boolean. Collaboration is required to reuse data from this study.
StudyCollaborationRequired.title: studyCollaborationRequired

StudyDataPermission.description: The list of entities or objects that define or enforce data sharing permissions. Maps to DUOplus4.
StudyDataPermission.title: studyDataPermission

StudyDataTier.description: The access tier(s) associated with the data in this study. Maps to DUOplus5.
StudyDataTier.title: studyDataTier

StudyDataUseModifiers.description: DUO code - A data item that is used to indicate consent permissions for datasets and/or materials and relates to the purposes for which datasets and/or material might be removed, stored, or used.
StudyDataUseModifiers.title: studyDataUseModifiers

StudyDbgapAccessionId.description: A stable unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to a study and any objects by the database of Genotypes and Phenotypes (dbGaP). Required for controlled access data being submitted to CDS/CRDC.
StudyDbgapAccessionId.title: studyDbgapAccessionId

StudyDeidentificationMethodDescription.description: Description of the process of removing potentially identifying data or data elements to render data into a form that does not identify individuals and where identification is not likely to take place.
StudyDeidentificationMethodDescription.title: studyDeidentificationMethodDescription

StudyDeidentificationMethodSoftware.description: Software that was used to de-identify the data (if used)
StudyDeidentificationMethodSoftware.title: studyDeidentificationMethodSoftware

StudyDeidentificationType.description: General description of the de-identification method. Maps to DUOplus3.
StudyDeidentificationType.title: studyDeidentificationType

StudyDescription.description: Description of the study, including the types of experimental assays, model systems, types of analysis, description of cohort, associated vulnerable populations, special categories of data, rare diseases, etc. Maps to DUOplus2.
StudyDescription.title: studyDescription

StudyDiseaseSpecificResearch.description: The list of diseases where data shared through this study is allowed to be reused.
StudyDiseaseSpecificResearch.title: studyDiseaseSpecificResearch

StudyGeographicalRestriction.description: The list of countries where this data is not allowed to be accessed.
StudyGeographicalRestriction.title: studyGeographicalRestriction

StudyId.description: A unique primary key that enables record updates using schematic.
StudyId.title: Study_id

StudyIndexDate.description: The reference event associated with timepoints in this study. One of Diagnosis Date, Enrollment Date, Collection Date, or Birth Date.
StudyIndexDate.title: studyIndexDate

StudyInstitutionSpecificRestriction.description: The list of institutions where access to this data is restricted.
StudyInstitutionSpecificRestriction.title: studyInstitutionSpecificRestriction

StudyInvestigator.description: Investigator(s) associated with the project. Multiple names should be provided as a comma-separated list.
StudyInvestigator.title: studyInvestigator

StudyLicense.description: Official or legal permission to do or own a specified thing. Studies with data that will be submitted to CDS are required to provide a license. Maps to DUOplus6.
StudyLicense.title: studyLicense

StudyParticipantNumber.description: The number of participant instances associated with systematic investigation into a subject.
StudyParticipantNumber.title: studyParticipantNumber

StudyPopulation.description: The population(s) associated with data shared through this study.
StudyPopulation.title: studyPopulation

StudyPublicationMoratorium.description: The date after which publications using data from this study are allowed to be published.
StudyPublicationMoratorium.title: studyPublicationMoratorium

StudyResearchSpecificRestrictions.description: The list of research types in which reuse of this data is allowed.
StudyResearchSpecificRestrictions.title: studyResearchSpecificRestrictions

StudySampleNumber.description: The number of specimens associated with systematic investigation into a subject.
StudySampleNumber.title: studySampleNumber

StudySourceGeography.description: The list of country(ies) where the data associated with this study was generated. Maps to DUOplus1.
StudySourceGeography.title: studySourceGeography

StudyTimeLimitOnUse.description: The amount of time a requestor is allowed access to data associated with this study.
StudyTimeLimitOnUse.title: studyTimeLimitOnUse

StudyUserSpecificRestriction.description: User-specific restrictions that must be satisfied before the requestor may access data from this study.
StudyUserSpecificRestriction.title: studyUserSpecificRestriction
